cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a bridal room — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a Guan Yu temple — sitting on the ground; an ancestral shrine hall with a bronze incense burner — lying on her side; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — perched on a ledge or edge; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — standing; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — standing; a small live house with a low stage — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — chest-deep in the water; a rocky coast path with tide pools — holds an umbrella open over her shoulder; an old stone chapel lit by candles — brings a small bouquet up to her face to smell the flowers; a foley recording booth with microphones and boxes of noisy props — holds her keepsake up beside her face
